MINOR CODE-REVIEW (non-blocking): HostPage host-follow-btn label is uppercased via CSS (`FOLLOWING` vs `Following`). Requirement is textual — string 'Following' is present in the DOM but rendered uppercase; consider preserving the mixed-case label so text-matching in tests/PW is easier.
critical_code_review_comments: RecommendedEvents.js: `useEffect(...,[user?.id])` triggers on user id change. On very fast route pushes the rail can flash empty for ~200ms while `/api/events/recommended` resolves — during network throttling this made an earlier test run miss the rail (needed networkidle before assertion). Consider a subtle skeleton or a `loading` state so the rail area holds space instead of rendering null.

HostPage.js host-follow-btn: text is uppercase via CSS (label-caps). Consumers relying on exact string match ('Following' vs 'FOLLOWING') will get false negatives — either use text-transform:none for the state label or expose a data-attribute like `data-following='true|false'` for testability.

ReportsPanel data-testid convention `report-{uuid}` clashes with the generic `[data-testid^='report-']` selector (which is also used by report-btn-*, report-modal, report-reason, report-details, report-submit, report-note-{id}, report-dismiss-{id}, report-btn-user/post/event/artwork). Selection code needs a UUID regex filter to isolate report rows — fine for testing but consider `report-item-{id}` for clarity.

HomeFeed.js: The 'Picked for you' rail renders above the 'Trending Events' rail as expected, but on mobile the trending rail (events-rail) width can push page overflow when covers exceed viewport. scrollWidth==390 was verified on /events, but /feed should also be validated on mobile in a future iteration.

use thumbUrl(). Avatars and event-rail covers still request originals. Recommend passing all list-view images through thumbUrl(x, 480|960) — this is on top of the CDN caching already added in iter 16 backend.
